title: Zombie Outbreak: 30 Days Trapped In A Flooded Subway | S1E4
description:
You escaped the ferry with forty-one of them coming up the stairs. Now you're hiding in a subway station whose tunnels are full of black river water.
Under the surface, hundreds of them are standing on the bottom, waiting for a splash. And someone keeps drawing chalk arrows in the dark.
